shared_design.architecture: One ordinary fixed-width prefill graph. CPU dequantizes selected Q4 embedding rows; HTP candidate covers all 30 layers, recurrent/attention updates, final norm, and final-position LM head. It returns N new K/V slices and 22 convolution/16 attention state outputs.
shared_design.attention_semantics: Each query attends to left-aligned valid prior cache positions and causal positions within its current chunk. Caller writes returned K/V slices into base:base+N.
shared_design.head_semantics: Only the chunk's final position enters the 22 symmetric Q4 logit chunks; CPU performs global greedy argmax.

fidelity_interpretation: Both chunks preserve the accepted symmetric-Q4 route's final greedy decision, including AR32 across two carried-state chunks. Numeric state/logit deltas are material and explicitly reported; only 20/38 AR32 and 19/38 AR128 state tensors meet rtol=0.02/atol=0.02. These probes do not establish exact numerical equivalence or output quality.
route_decision: AR32 and AR128 both compile fully to one QNN subgraph. Neither alone exactly tiles the 171-token canonical short prompt. Next probe AR57 (three equal chunks) and AR171 (single prompt chunk) to avoid padding/tail-context complexity, then host-execute the most practical candidate before a phone request.
